S: Harper and Charlie sharing pizza in the empty office
Pizza dough stretched thin, topped with tomato sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked at 250C for 10 minutes, eaten straight from the box.

Franks grilled until split, in soft buns with mustard and fried onions, wrapped in paper. Fry 2 sliced onions slowly until soft and golden. Grill 8 hot dog franks until they split. Tuck into soft buns with the onions and yellow mustard and wrap in paper. Hand them to the bosses as the kiss cam swings around.
Stadium pretzel bites with cheese sauce
the baseball game where Harper and Charlie set up the kiss cam

Bite-sized soft pretzels boiled in a bicarb bath, salted and baked golden, served warm with a smooth cheddar and beer cheese sauce. Make a dough with 375g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 5 minutes and rest 45 minutes. Heat the oven to 220C. Roll into ropes and cut into 3cm pieces. Boil in 2L water with 60g bicarb soda for 20 seconds, drain, brush with egg, sprinkle with salt and bake 12 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 200ml milk and 60ml lager, then 150g grated cheddar until smooth.
M: the assistants playing matchmaker for their bosses

Sirloin steaks seared and rested, sliced with a cream and peppercorn sauce, crispy roast potatoes and buttered asparagus. Roast 1kg potato chunks at 220C for 45 minutes. Sear 4 sirloin steaks and rest. Toast cracked peppercorns in the pan, add 200ml cream and simmer until thick. Steam asparagus and toss with butter. Serve on white plates.
the assistants working past midnight in New York

Egg noodles wok-tossed with crispy chicken, broccolini and capsicum in a sticky soy, honey and garlic sauce, sesame and spring onion on top, served in takeaway boxes. Slice 500g chicken thighs and toss with 1 tbsp cornflour and 1 tbsp soy. Mix 3 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tsp sesame oil and 2 crushed garlic cloves. Soak 400g fresh egg noodles in hot water for 2 minutes and drain. Stir-fry the chicken in a hot wok with oil for 5 minutes until crisp. Add 1 bunch broccolini and 1 sliced red capsicum for 2 minutes, then the noodles and sauce. Toss 2 minutes and top with sesame seeds and spring onion.
W: the office parties the assistants have to organise
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, cooled and piped with vanilla buttercream and sprinkles.
K: Iced salted caramel latte for the boss
Harper and Charlie fetching coffee for their bosses

Double espresso poured over ice and cold milk, swirled with homemade salted caramel and topped with lightly whipped cream and a pinch of sea salt. Make the caramel: melt 100g caster sugar in a saucepan until amber, take off the heat and whisk in 60ml cream and 20g butter, then half a tsp sea salt. Cool. Pull 4 double shots of espresso. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice, add 2 tbsp caramel and 200ml cold milk to each, then pour the espresso over. Top with whipped cream (100ml whipped) and a pinch of salt.
